title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 4 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe. In this low-risk patient no routine follow-up is recommended (Fleischner 2017). Otherwise normal chest CT.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid <6 mm in a low-risk patient needs no routine follow-up.

title: CT chest with contrast
text:
FINDINGS: Solitary 5 mm solid nodule in the RML. Mild centrilobular emphysema. No lymphadenopathy.
IMPRESSION: 5 mm RML nodule. Emphysema.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid <6 mm even in a high-risk patient carries only an optional 12-month CT, not a required follow-up.

title: CTA chest (PE protocol)
text:
IMPRESSION:
1. No pulmonary embolism.
2. Incidental 9 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe. Recommend follow-up chest CT in 3 months; PET/CT or tissue sampling are alternatives.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid >8 mm -> CT at 3 months, PET/CT or sampling regardless of risk; explicit CT recommendation.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: 우상엽에 6 mm 고형 결절. 12개월 후 추적 CT 권고.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: 6-8 mm solid nodule -> CT at 6-12 months; report recommends 12-month CT.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple bilateral solid pulmonary nodules, the largest 7 mm in the RLL. Differential includes infectious/inflammatory etiology. Recommend follow-up CT in 3-6 months.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: multiple solid nodules 6-8 mm -> CT at 3-6 months.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Densely calcified 8 mm granuloma in the RUL. No suspicious pulmonary nodule.
rationale: Diffusely calcified nodule is benign; Fleischner follow-up not required.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 6 mm triangular nodule abutting the right minor fissure, typical of an intrapulmonary lymph node (perifissural nodule). No follow-up needed.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: typical perifissural nodules need no follow-up even when >6 mm.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: The previously described 7 mm RUL solid nodule is unchanged since CT of 03/2024 (more than 2 years of stability), consistent with a benign etiology. No further follow-up.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid nodule stable for 2 years needs no further follow-up.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: RLL solid nodule now measures 11 mm, increased from 7 mm on 09/2025. Findings are concerning for malignancy. Recommend PET/CT and pulmonology referral.
rationale: Growing solid nodule (>=2 mm growth) is suspicious and needs PET/CT, sampling or referral.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: 좌상엽 부분고형 결절 18 mm, 고형 성분 8 mm로 6개월 전 CT와 비교하여 지속됨. 악성 가능성 배제 못함. PET-CT 및 조직검사 고려 바랍니다.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: persistent part-solid nodule with solid component >=6 mm is highly suspicious -> work-up; R036 not applied to lung nodules.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Single 8 mm pure ground-glass nodule in the LUL. Recommend CT in 6-12 months to confirm persistence.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: ground-glass nodule >=6 mm -> CT at 6-12 months to confirm persistence.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 5 mm ground-glass opacity in the RUL. Per Fleischner, no routine follow-up for a solitary GGN <6 mm.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solitary pure GGN <6 mm needs no routine follow-up.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Part-solid nodule in the RLL measuring 9 mm with a 3 mm solid component. Recommend follow-up CT in 3-6 months to assess persistence.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: part-solid >=6 mm -> CT at 3-6 months.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text:
IMPRESSION:
1. No acute abdominal or pelvic process.
2. Incidental 7 mm solid nodule at the partially imaged left lung base.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: 6-8 mm solid nodule needs CT at 6-12 months at any risk level, even without a stated recommendation.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Solitary 7 mm solid nodule in the RML. Given young age this is likely benign; nevertheless a follow-up CT in 12 months is suggested.
rationale: Fleischner does not apply under 35 years (human review); the explicit radiologist CT recommendation still opens.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Two new solid nodules in the right lower lobe (5 mm and 6 mm), suspicious for metastases in this patient with colon cancer. Recommend short-interval chest CT in 3 months.
rationale: Fleischner excludes patients with known cancer; the explicit 3-month CT recommendation opens.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple scattered nodules with surrounding ground-glass halo in both lungs in this renal transplant recipient, concerning for fungal infection. Recommend bronchoscopy with BAL correlation and follow-up CT after 4-6 weeks of therapy.
rationale: Fleischner excludes immunocompromised patients; explicit follow-up CT recommendation opens.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 6 mm RUL solid nodule is stable compared with CT from 7 months ago. In this high-risk patient, recommend follow-up CT at 18-24 months from initial detection.
rationale: Fleischner 2017 high risk 6-8 mm: CT at 6-12 months, then CT at 18-24 months (stepped follow-up).

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No pulmonary nodule or mass. Mild centrilobular emphysema. No pleural effusion.
rationale: Negated finding; nothing to follow.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Previously noted 10 mm RLL nodule has resolved, consistent with an inflammatory etiology. No new nodules.
rationale: Resolved nodule; no follow-up required.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 2 - benign appearance or behavior. 5 mm solid nodule in the RUL. Continue annual screening.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022 category 2: continue routine annual screening; no interval follow-up obligation.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text:
Baseline screening.
IMPRESSION: 7 mm solid nodule in the RLL. Lung-RADS 3, probably benign. Recommend 6-month LDCT.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 6 to <8 mm = category 3 -> 6-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text: 기저 검진. 좌상엽 9 mm 고형 결절. Lung-RADS 4A. 3개월 후 저선량 CT 권고.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 8 to <15 mm = 4A -> 3-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (annual)
text: IMPRESSION: RLL solid nodule increased from 8 mm to 16 mm since prior annual screen. Lung-RADS 4B. Recommend PET/CT and pulmonology referral for tissue sampling.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: growing solid nodule >=8 mm = 4B -> diagnostic work-up; Lung-RADS governs screening nodules.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening
text: IMPRESSION: 12 mm part-solid nodule with spiculated margins in the LUL. Lung-RADS 4X.
rationale: Lung-RADS 4X requires diagnostic work-up (CT, PET/CT, sampling or referral).

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT
text: Lung-RADS 1. 폐결절 없음. 1년 후 정기 검진.
rationale: Lung-RADS 1: continue annual screening only.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text: IMPRESSION: Baseline study. 10 mm part-solid nodule in the RUL with a 3 mm solid component. Lung-RADS 3.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline part-solid >=6 mm with solid component <6 mm = category 3.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (6개월 추적)
text: 6개월 추적 LDCT: 이전 Lung-RADS 3 결절 (우중엽 7 mm) 변화 없음. Lung-RADS 2로 하향 조정. 12개월 후 연례 검진.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: category 3 nodule stable at 6 months is downgraded to 2 -> annual screening only.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (3-month follow-up)
text: IMPRESSION: Previously 10 mm LLL nodule (Lung-RADS 4A) has decreased to 6 mm with ill-defined margins, likely inflammatory. Lung-RADS 2. Resume annual screening.
rationale: Decreasing nodule recategorised Lung-RADS 2: return to annual screening.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (annual)
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 4A. New 7 mm solid nodule in the RML, not present on prior annual screen.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: new solid 6 to <8 mm = 4A -> 3-month LDCT.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: Lung-RADS 4B. 좌하엽 22 mm 분엽상 고형 결절. PET-CT 및 조직검사 권고.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid >=15 mm = 4B -> work-up; R036 not applied under Lung-RADS.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: 기저 검사. 우하엽 6 mm 고형결절. Lung-RADS 3.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 6 to <8 mm = category 3 -> 6-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 4A: 11 mm solid nodule in the LUL at baseline. Recommend 3-month LDCT.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 8 to <15 mm = 4A.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: 기저 검진. 우상엽 부분고형 결절 14 mm, 고형 성분 6 mm. Lung-RADS 4A.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: part-solid with solid component 6 to <8 mm at baseline = 4A.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (annual)
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 4B. New 9 mm solid nodule in the LLL. Recommend PET/CT; consider tissue sampling.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: new solid nodule >=8 mm = 4B.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: 기저 검사. 좌상엽 순수 간유리 결절 32 mm. Lung-RADS 3. 6개월 후 저선량 CT 권고.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline GGN >=30 mm = category 3.

title: Diagnostic mammogram and breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 1.1 cm irregular hypoechoic mass with indistinct margins at 10 o'clock, 4 cm FN, left breast. BI-RADS 4B: moderate suspicion for malignancy. Ultrasound-guided core biopsy is recommended.
rationale: BI-RADS 4 requires tissue diagnosis; R036 not applied when BI-RADS governs.

title: Screening mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: No mammographic evidence of malignancy. BI-RADS 1: Negative. Routine annual screening.
rationale: BI-RADS 1: routine screening only.

title: 유방 초음파
text: 우측 유방 2시 방향, 유두로부터 3 cm에 1.4 cm 크기의 불규칙한 저에코 종괴, 후방음영 동반. BI-RADS 5. 조직검사 권고.
rationale: BI-RADS 5 requires biopsy.

title: Breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 0.8 cm oval circumscribed parallel hypoechoic mass at 3 o'clock right breast, probably fibroadenoma. BI-RADS 3: Probably benign. Recommend follow-up ultrasound in 6 months.
rationale: BI-RADS 3: short-interval (6-month) follow-up; explicit ultrasound recommendation.

title: 진단 유방촬영술
text: 좌측 유방 상외측에 segmental 분포의 fine pleomorphic 미세석회화. BI-RADS 4C. 정위 생검 권고.
rationale: BI-RADS 4C requires tissue diagnosis.

title: Diagnostic mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: Known biopsy-proven malignancy in the right breast, preoperative extent evaluation. No additional suspicious findings in either breast. BI-RADS 6.
rationale: BI-RADS 6: malignancy already proven; no new biopsy obligation.

title: Breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 1.2 cm simple cyst at 7 o'clock left breast. BI-RADS 2: Benign.
rationale: Simple cyst, BI-RADS 2: no follow-up.

title: Screening mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: New 8 mm spiculated mass with associated architectural distortion in the right breast upper outer quadrant. BI-RADS 5: highly suggestive of malignancy. Recommend biopsy.
rationale: BI-RADS 5 requires biopsy.

title: Breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm circumscribed but microlobulated hypoechoic mass at 1 o'clock right breast, not seen on prior. BI-RADS 4A: low suspicion. US-guided biopsy recommended.
rationale: BI-RADS 4A still requires tissue diagnosis.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Left lobe 1.6 cm solid, markedly hypoechoic nodule with irregular margins and punctate echogenic foci. ACR TI-RADS TR5 (10 points). FNA recommended.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR5 >=1.0 cm -> FNA.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text: 우엽 1.2 cm 등에코 고형 결절, TI-RADS TR4. 세침흡인 기준(1.5 cm) 미달로 1년 후 초음파 추적 권고.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR4 1.0-1.4 cm -> follow-up US (1 year).

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple spongiform nodules bilaterally, largest 2.2 cm in the right lobe. TI-RADS TR1. No FNA or follow-up required.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS TR1: no FNA, no follow-up.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Right lobe 2.8 cm mixed cystic and solid isoechoic nodule, TI-RADS TR3. Meets size criteria for FNA (>=2.5 cm).
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR3 >=2.5 cm -> FNA.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text: 좌엽 0.7 cm 고형 저에코 결절, 미세석회화 동반, TI-RADS TR5. 1년 후 추적 초음파 권고.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR5 0.5-0.9 cm -> annual follow-up US.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text: 좌엽 1.7 cm 저에코 고형 결절, 경계 평활, 종횡비 정상. TI-RADS TR4 (5점). 세침흡인검사 권고.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR4 >=1.5 cm -> FNA.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Previously biopsied right 1.8 cm nodule (Bethesda II, 2024) is stable in size and appearance. TR3. No further FNA or imaging follow-up required.
rationale: Nodule already worked up with benign cytology; radiologist states no further follow-up.

title: CT neck with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No cervical lymphadenopathy. Incidental 2.1 cm heterogeneous nodule in the right thyroid lobe. Recommend dedicated thyroid ultrasound.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: nodule >=1.5 cm in patient >=35 -> thyroid US.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No acute cardiopulmonary findings. Incidental 1.0 cm hypodense left thyroid nodule without suspicious features.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: <1.5 cm in a patient >=35 without suspicious features -> no further evaluation.

title: FDG PET/CT (staging)
text: IMPRESSION: 1. FDG-avid right hilar mass consistent with known lung cancer, no distant metastasis. 2. Focal FDG uptake in the right thyroid lobe (SUVmax 8.2) corresponding to a 1.1 cm nodule. Recommend thyroid ultrasound.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: any focal FDG-avid thyroid nodule -> thyroid US regardless of size.

title: 경부 CT
text: 경부 림프절 비대 없음. 갑상선 우엽에 1.2 cm 저음영 결절이 우연히 발견됨.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: in patients <35 years, nodule >=1 cm -> thyroid US.

title: MRI cervical spine
text: IMPRESSION: Multilevel degenerative disc disease, worst at C5-6 with moderate left foraminal narrowing. Incidental 1.3 cm left thyroid nodule.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: 1.3 cm in a 50-year-old without suspicious features -> no further work-up.

title: FDG PET/CT
text: IMPRESSION: No FDG-avid metastatic disease in this patient with treated breast cancer. Diffuse homogeneous thyroid FDG uptake, consistent with thyroiditis; no focal thyroid uptake.
rationale: Diffuse thyroid uptake (thyroiditis) does not require ultrasound; only focal uptake does.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Incidental 1.6 cm left adrenal nodule measuring 28 HU on portal venous phase only, indeterminate. No prior imaging available.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 1-2 cm nodule without cancer history -> adrenal CT/MRI in 12 months.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.8 cm right adrenal nodule measuring 6 HU on unenhanced images, consistent with a lipid-rich adenoma. No further imaging needed.
rationale: ACR adrenal: <=10 HU on unenhanced CT is a benign adenoma.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌측 부신에 2.8 cm 결절, 조영 전 25 HU. 비특이적 소견으로 부신 프로토콜 CT 권고.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 2-4 cm nodule -> characterise with adrenal protocol CT/MRI.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: New 1.4 cm right adrenal nodule (35 HU) in this patient with known NSCLC, suspicious for metastasis.
rationale: ACR adrenal: nodule >=1 cm in a patient with cancer -> PET/CT, biopsy or specialist work-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 4.6 cm heterogeneous left adrenal mass with central necrosis. Recommend endocrine and surgical referral.
rationale: ACR adrenal: mass >=4 cm -> referral/resection consideration.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Left adrenal 2.1 cm nodule containing macroscopic fat, consistent with myelolipoma. No follow-up required.
rationale: Myelolipoma is benign; ACR adrenal excludes it.

title: 복부 MRI
text: 우측 부신 1.5 cm 결절, chemical shift 영상에서 뚜렷한 신호 소실을 보여 지방 풍부 선종에 합당함.
rationale: Signal drop on chemical-shift MRI = lipid-rich adenoma (benign).

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Stable 1.9 cm left adrenal nodule compared with CT from 2023 (3 years), consistent with a benign adenoma.
rationale: ACR adrenal: stable >=1 year is benign; no follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No evidence of metastatic disease. 0.7 cm left adrenal nodule, too small to characterize.
rationale: ACR adrenal: nodules <1 cm need no follow-up even with cancer history.

title: Adrenal protocol CT
text: IMPRESSION: 1.7 cm left adrenal nodule: unenhanced 18 HU, absolute washout 72%. Consistent with adenoma. No further imaging.
rationale: ACR adrenal: absolute washout >=60% = adenoma; already characterised.

title: 복부 CT
text: 간세포암 치료 후 추적. 좌측 부신에 새로 생긴 2.3 cm 결절, 30 HU. 전이 배제 불가.
rationale: ACR adrenal: new nodule >=1 cm in a cancer patient -> work-up for metastasis.

title: 복부 CT
text: 우측 부신 1.3 cm 결절, 문맥기 단일 시기에서 40 HU로 특성화 불가.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 1-2 cm nodule -> 12-month adrenal CT/MRI.

title: MRI abdomen without and with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.5 cm left adrenal nodule without signal loss on opposed-phase imaging, indeterminate. Recommend adrenal protocol CT with washout.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 2-4 cm -> adrenal protocol CT characterisation.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌측 부신에 6.0 cm 크기의 종괴, 내부 괴사 및 석회화 동반. 부신피질암 가능성. 내분비내과 및 외과 협진 권고.
rationale: ACR adrenal: mass >=4 cm -> specialist work-up.

title: FDG PET/CT (staging)
text: IMPRESSION: Right adrenal 2.6 cm nodule with FDG uptake greater than liver (SUVmax 6.0) in this patient with esophageal cancer, suspicious for metastasis.
rationale: ACR adrenal: nodule >=1 cm in cancer patient, FDG-avid -> work-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.5 cm left renal cyst with thin smooth wall, 5 HU. Bosniak I. No follow-up.
rationale: Bosniak I simple cyst: no follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.8 cm right renal cystic lesion with multiple thin septa and a minimally thickened smooth wall. Bosniak IIF. Recommend follow-up renal mass protocol MRI in 6 months.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 IIF -> follow-up CT/MRI at 6 months.

title: 신장 초음파
text: 좌신 상극에 1.5 cm 고에코 결절. 혈관근지방종 가능성 높으나 신세포암 배제 위해 조영증강 CT 권고.
rationale: ACR renal: echogenic renal lesion >=1 cm on US is indeterminate -> CT to confirm fat.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.2 cm fat-containing lesion in the left kidney consistent with angiomyolipoma.
rationale: Macroscopic fat = angiomyolipoma: excluded from follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple bilateral subcentimeter renal hypodensities, too small to characterize, statistically likely cysts. No further imaging.
rationale: ACR renal: lesions too small to characterise need no follow-up.

title: MRI kidneys without and with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.9 cm left renal cystic mass with thick, irregular enhancing septa. Bosniak III. Urology consultation recommended.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 III -> urology referral (surgery/ablation/active surveillance discussion).

title: 복부 CT
text: 우신 하극에 4.1 cm 크기의 조영증강되는 고형 종괴, 신세포암 의심. 비뇨의학과 의뢰 바람.
rationale: ACR renal: solid enhancing renal mass -> urology referral.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast (portal venous)
text: IMPRESSION: 1.6 cm homogeneous lesion in the right kidney measuring 45 HU on portal venous phase only, indeterminate (hyperdense cyst versus solid mass).
rationale: ACR renal: homogeneous 21-69 HU on single portal venous phase, >=1 cm -> renal mass protocol imaging.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.2 cm solid enhancing right renal mass (unenhanced 32 HU, nephrographic 110 HU), suspicious for renal cell carcinoma. Recommend urology referral and percutaneous biopsy given comorbidities.
rationale: Enhancing solid renal mass -> urology; explicit biopsy recommendation (renal mass not excluded from R036).

title: Renal ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Simple 3.1 cm cyst in the right kidney. Otherwise normal kidneys without hydronephrosis.
rationale: Simple renal cyst: no follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Homogeneous 1.4 cm left renal lesion measuring 78 HU on unenhanced CT, consistent with a hemorrhagic/proteinaceous cyst (Bosniak II).
rationale: Bosniak v2019: homogeneous >=70 HU on unenhanced CT is Bosniak II -> no follow-up.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌신 2.0 cm 낭종, 얇은 격막 2개 동반. Bosniak II. 추적 불필요.
rationale: Bosniak II: no follow-up.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌신 중극에 3.4 cm 낭성 종괴, 조영증강되는 벽재결절 동반. Bosniak IV. 비뇨의학과 진료 권고.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 IV -> urology referral.

title: 신장 MRI
text: 우신 2.4 cm 낭종, 다수의 얇은 격막과 경미하게 두꺼워진 매끈한 벽. Bosniak IIF. 6개월 후 추적 검사 권고.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 IIF -> 6-month follow-up imaging (modality not specified).

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.5 cm heterogeneously hyperattenuating lesion in the upper pole of the left kidney, incompletely characterized on this single-phase study. Recommend renal mass protocol CT.
rationale: ACR renal: indeterminate lesion >=1 cm -> renal mass protocol CT/MRI.

title: MRI/MRCP abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 1.1 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic body communicating with a side branch, likely side-branch IPMN. No worrisome features. Recommend MRI/MRCP in 2 years.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: <1.5 cm -> MRI every 2 years.

title: 복부 CT
text: 췌장 두부에 3.1 cm 낭성 병변, 주췌관 확장이나 고형 성분 없음. 6개월 후 MRCP 추적 권고.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: >2.5 cm -> MRI at 6 months (or EUS-FNA).

title: MRI/MRCP abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 2.4 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic head with a 6 mm enhancing mural nodule; main pancreatic duct dilated to 8 mm. Worrisome features. Recommend EUS and pancreatic surgery consultation.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: mural nodule / MPD >=7 mm -> EUS / pancreas specialist.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1. No acute findings. 2. Incidental 0.8 cm cyst in the pancreatic body.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: <1.5 cm -> MRI/MRCP in 2 years.

title: MRCP
text: 췌장 체부에 1.8 cm 분지형 IPMN 의심 병변. 벽재결절 없음, 주췌관 4 mm.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: 1.5-2.5 cm -> MRI/MRCP at 1 year.

title: MRI/MRCP abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: Stable 1.0 cm pancreatic tail cyst, unchanged since 2017 (9 years). Per ACR guidance, surveillance can be discontinued.
